ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Scarlands Ladder
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
STAGED_LORE_BUILD_1, content half — the Scarlands reveal ladder as data for mandrake.rm.lorestages.
Five rungs, matching design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_scarlands.md §GM 1-5: the last stand, the Sentinels, the Cathedral, the Rakata, the pilgrims. Each rung rewrites RUT_Scarlands' description and settleWarning so the biome reads as an inexplicable wasteland until the player has earned the truth.
The five description rungs are the ruled text (cast bible section 6B, card 2026-09-30); the two settleWarning rungs are still placeholder and marked as such. The gate is the pilgrim camps: a cold fire, a bedroll, the pilgrim who never left and a journal, placed on RUT_Scarlands maps; reading a journal moves the ladder one rung (setting: Scarlands Ladder). R25 (freeze ruling): even the top rung never names the Assailants, the Rakata, scaria's authorship or the Cathedral's nature in a def description. Staged text advances from absence to geometry the player reads, never to a name they are handed. That ban is a property of THIS table, not of the engine, and applies to the real text when it lands.
The engine and the split: the mechanism is mandrake.rm.lorestages (RimMandrake tier — it names no campaign); this mod is the RimUtinni half, per the engine/content rule in design/NAMING_SCHEME_PLAN.md §2.
